subject: c-info
title: C.INFO.------INFO.AF.B.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 47 (WM-23). C-INFO (composite information) is the subject; INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) is the partner, whose label sits at the point on the subject's line where the long line to LANG branches off; the subject's line continues past it to AF-DY. From INFO-AF-B: AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and LANG (language). From AF-DY: EXT-F (extended functionalism). From EXT-F: MT-INFO (multi-information). From LANG: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) and PART (participation), with the (DT) prefix. From PART: ST, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; INFO-DE (information degrees) is on a dotted line from PART. From INFO-DE: RT-ALGN (reality alignment).
